boundary: Documentation-sourced. Not one of these names was seen over the MCP transport: agent.robinhood.com refuses this egress at the CDN edge, so tools/list was never reached.
providerSentence: Your agent can make the following tools. We'll be adding more tools in future releases.

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: View all your Robinhood accounts

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get a snapshot of your portfolio, including total value, values by asset class, and real-time buying power

tools.name: get_realized_pnl
tools.description: View realized profit and loss for your account over a custom time window, broken down by asset class

tools.name: get_pnl_trade_history
tools.description: View your trade-by-trade realized P&L history

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find a company name or partial name to a ticker

tools.name: get_watchlists
tools.description: List user's watchlists

tools.name: get_watchlist_items
tools.description: List symbols in a specific watchlist

tools.name: get_option_watchlist
tools.description: Load an options watchlist

tools.name: get_popular_watchlists
tools.description: Discover Robinhood lists (like '100 most popular')

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description: Make a new custom watchlist.

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description: Rename or update a watchlist's name description

tools.name: follow_watchlist
tools.description: Follow a Robinhood list

tools.name: unfollow_watchlist
tools.description: Stop following a Robinhood list

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add stocks, crypto, or indexes to a watchlist

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove stocks, crypto, or indexes from a watchlist

tools.name: add_option_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add an options contract to a watchlist

tools.name: remove_option_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove an options contract from a watchlist

tools.name: get_equity_historicals
tools.description: Get OHLCV price bars across a time range

tools.name: get_equity_fundamentals
tools.description: Get valuation ratios, market cap, 52-week range, dividend info, and today's OHLCV

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Get a company's reported financials over time - revenue, gross profit, net income, and net margin - by quarter or year for one or more stocks

tools.name: get_equity_price_book
tools.description: Get a real-time Level 2 order book showing bid/ask price levels and resting size on each side, for up to 4 stocks

tools.name: get_equity_technical_indicators
tools.description: Compute a technical indicator (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, moving averages, and more) for a stock over a time range

tools.name: get_earnings_results
tools.description: Look up a specific stock's earnings history and next report. See estimated vs. actual EPS for recent quarters, plus the upcoming quarter's estimate and report date.

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: List earnings reports scheduled across the market over a date window (up to 31 days), optionally limited to large-cap names

tools.name: get_indexes
tools.description: Look up market indexes by symbol

tools.name: get_index_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time index values

tools.name: get_equity_positions
tools.description: View open equity positions with quantity and cost basis

tools.name: get_equity_tax_lots
tools.description: View the open tax lots for an equity holding, each with its quantity, cost basis, acquisition date, and long/short-term status

tools.name: get_equity_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time equity quotes and prior close for up to 20 symbols

tools.name: get_equity_orders
tools.description: Get equity order status history

tools.name: get_equity_tradability
tools.description: Check if a symbol can be traded and find out if it can be traded fractionally

tools.name: review_equity_order
tools.description: Simulate an equity order and get pre-trade warnings

tools.name: place_equity_order
tools.description: Place an equity order

tools.name: cancel_equity_order
tools.description: Cancel an open equity order

tools.name: get_option_level_upgrade_info
tools.description: Get a link to apply for options trading access on an account

tools.name: get_option_historicals
tools.description: Get OHLC price bars for option contracts across a time range

tools.name: get_option_chains
tools.description: Load option chains

tools.name: get_option_instruments
tools.description: Load option contracts filtered by expiry, strike, or type

tools.name: get_option_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time quotes for option contracts

tools.name: get_option_positions
tools.description: View open or closed options positions

tools.name: get_option_orders
tools.description: Get options order history

tools.name: review_option_order
tools.description: Simulate an options order with pre-trade alerts

tools.name: cancel_option_order
tools.description: Cancel an open options order

tools.name: place_option_order
tools.description: Place a real options order

tools.name: get_currency_pairs
tools.description: List Robinhood-supported crypto assets

tools.name: get_crypto_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time bid/ask/mark prices plus previous close for one or more crypto assets

tools.name: get_crypto_positions
tools.description: List all positions across all crypto accounts.

tools.name: get_crypto_orders
tools.description: Get crypto order history

tools.name: preview_crypto_order
tools.description: Preview a crypto order

tools.name: place_crypto_order
tools.description: Place a real crypto order

tools.name: cancel_crypto_order
tools.description: Cancel an open crypto order

tools.name: get_scans
tools.description: List your saved scans

tools.name: get_scanner_filter_specs
tools.description: List every available scanner filter and how to use it before building or updating a scan

tools.name: create_scan
tools.description: Create a new scan from a starting preset or with your own custom filters

tools.name: run_scan
tools.description: Run a saved scan and get live market results

tools.name: update_scan_filters
tools.description: Change the filters on an existing saved scan

tools.name: update_scan_config
tools.description: Change the way results are sorted
